changes.title: Amazon MWAA now supports fine-grained access control with IAM Identity Center and multi-team environments
changes.detail: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) now supports fine-grained access control, giving administrators precise control over who can access which workflows and resources in an Apache Airflow environment. Fine-grained access control is delivered through two new capabilities: IAM Identity Center integration and multi-team environments. With IAM Identity Center integration, users sign in to the Apache Airflow UI with their corporate identity provider.
